facts.fact: SMART Zambia National Coordinator Percy Chinyama said on Mwinilunga Radio on 7 July 2026 that SmartCare Pro has been deployed in approximately 80% of health facilities nationwide; no numerator or denominator is given and the share is of all health facilities, not primary clinics alone.

SMART Zambia's national coordinator said on 7 July 2026 that government aims at full national coverage of SmartCare Pro, as part of the digitalisation programme launched in 2021; the document names no strategy paper or costing.
